name: Taj Mahal
shortDescription: Ivory-white marble mausoleum built by Shah Jahan for Mumtaz Mahal.

name: Agra Fort
shortDescription: Mughal-era red sandstone fort on the banks of the Yamuna.

name: Fatehpur Sikri
shortDescription: Mughal capital city built by Akbar, now a UNESCO World Heritage ghost city.

name: Qutub Minar
shortDescription: 73-metre tall minaret of red sandstone and marble, begun in 1192.

name: Red Fort
shortDescription: Mughal fortified palace, site of the Independence Day flag hoisting.

name: Humayun's Tomb
shortDescription: Garden tomb of Mughal Emperor Humayun, precursor to the Taj Mahal's design.

name: Hawa Mahal
shortDescription: Five-storey pink sandstone palace with 953 small windows (jharokhas).

name: Amer Fort
shortDescription: Hilltop fort-palace of honey-coloured sandstone and marble overlooking Maota Lake.

name: Mehrangarh Fort
shortDescription: One of India's largest forts, rising 120m above Jodhpur's Blue City.

name: Jaisalmer Fort
shortDescription: A living desert fort where thousands still reside within its sandstone walls.

name: Gateway of India
shortDescription: Arch monument built to commemorate King George V's 1911 visit.

name: Ajanta Caves
shortDescription: 2nd-century BCE Buddhist rock-cut cave monuments with renowned murals.

name: Ellora Caves
shortDescription: Rock-cut Hindu, Buddhist and Jain monuments, including the Kailasa temple.

name: Mysore Palace
shortDescription: Indo-Saracenic royal residence of the Wadiyar dynasty.

name: Hampi Group of Monuments
shortDescription: Ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire capital, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
shortDescription: Historic Dravidian-style temple with towering, sculpture-covered gopurams.

name: Brihadeeswarar Temple
shortDescription: 11th-century Chola-era granite temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Mahabalipuram Shore Temple
shortDescription: 8th-century Pallava-era shore temple complex on the Bay of Bengal.

name: Konark Sun Temple
shortDescription: 13th-century temple shaped as a colossal chariot of the sun god Surya.

name: Khajuraho Group of Monuments
shortDescription: Nagara-style Hindu and Jain temples renowned for their intricate sculptures.

name: Sanchi Stupa
shortDescription: Ancient Buddhist complex, among the oldest stone structures in India.

name: Golden Temple
shortDescription: Sikhism's holiest gurdwara, its upper floors gilded with pure gold.

name: Majuli Island
shortDescription: One of the world's largest river islands, home to Vaishnavite satras.

name: Kaziranga National Park
shortDescription: UNESCO World Heritage wildlife sanctuary, home to two-thirds of the world's one-horned rhinos.

name: Living Root Bridges, Cherrapunji
shortDescription: Bioengineered bridges grown from rubber fig tree roots by the Khasi people.

name: Rumtek Monastery
shortDescription: The largest monastery in Sikkim, seat-in-exile of the Karmapa Lama.

name: Basilica of Bom Jesus
shortDescription: Baroque church holding the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier.

name: Charminar
shortDescription: 1591 mosque-monument with four grand arches, the icon of Hyderabad.

name: Rani ki Vav
shortDescription: An intricately carved 11th-century stepwell, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Victoria Memorial
shortDescription: White marble memorial and museum dedicated to Queen Victoria.

name: Sun Temple, Modhera
shortDescription: 11th-century temple dedicated to the sun god, aligned to the equinox sunrise.
